items.description: The historical residence of Justo José de Urquiza, a key figure in Argentina's constitutional development.
A historic colonial house associated with Viceroy Santiago de Liniers, reflecting colonial history.
The birthplace and historical home of Domingo Faustino Sarmiento, a former Argentine president.
A well-preserved colonial building that functioned as the administrative center in Salta.
A historic convent in Salta, showcasing impressive colonial architecture and religious heritage.
Archaeological ruins in the Salta region, reflecting the lifestyle of indigenous cultures.
A mountain fortress demonstrating advanced indigenous engineering in the Catamarca region.
A collection of ancient carved stones, significant for its pre-colonial cultural and artistic value.
A historic chapel with religious and community importance, reflecting colonial social structures.
The birthplace of General José de San Martín, a site of immense historical pride for Argentina.
